summary: Fix a source comment in archive_rehearsal.py that named a test class, RebuildRehearsalBlockerEndToEndVerifiedSuccessTests, which has never existed under that name; corrected to reference the real, existing RebuildRehearsalBlockerEndToEndBuildTests a fresh, independent re-review found.
